question: Can duplicating the SAME realized q into both evidence columns recover performance without explicit z information, while preserving single-memory RNN competence, individualized structure and observation-training compensation?

design.crossing: All three training pairs crossed with all three panels. Only three independent training pairs. Identical initialization and base task stream within A/C pair. Identical physical input, observation draw, choice RNG and interventions across four cells within panel.

statistics.unit: Joint resampling of the original participant IDs across four cells within each network; generic episodes and Liu participants separate. Never treat participant pairs as independent or pool networks. Duplicate sampled IDs are separate bootstrap observations as in the parent contract. Conditional masks applied after resampling, no common-mask restriction. Any undefined conditional draw makes its interval undefined; retain its count. Scalar CE and shifts must be finite for all subjects or stop.

estimands.tau: For each contrast, recompute the weighted pairwise Kendall tau of each cell in shared-ID bootstrap samples. Primary global_all77; also full_all77, full_conditional and global_conditional. Report each cell and simple effects, not interaction alone.
estimands.CE: Per-episode CE=mean(logaddexp(0,-margin*true_sign/T)). Generic T=1, full/global separately; global CE interaction aligns with primary structure and full CE retains task-output context. Liu T=0.25, full/global separately as secondary; never pool tasks or temperatures. All four simple/cross contrasts for each endpoint.
estimands.order_shift: Global S_R=mean_i[(1-KendallTau(order_R0_i,order_Re_i))/2], equivalently fraction of the 28 item pairs reversed within each subject. Report S_A,S_C and participant-paired S_C-S_A using replay0, deterministic internal orders, unchanged tie ordering. No sampled choices enter this endpoint.
estimands.absolute_behavior: Retain inherited full/global competence and five core flags for each cell, plus P_off/evidence-shuffle evidence binding. Full-policy historical profiles remain descriptive; no promotion or human-distribution matching.

change: After unchanged clean/noisy encoding, copy support channel37(q) into channel34. Both columns receive exactly the same realized q, with no new noise draw. Preserve all other arrays, 38-dimensional initialization, local=None, 1500x32 single-stage training, Adam, clipping, temperatures, sigma, tasks and panels. No new gate or persistent state; p/z still generate q.
references: H=(zq,q): six frozen single-memory models and36 cells. Z=(0,q): six frozen zero-hint models and36 cells. D=(q,q): ONLY six newly trained matched models and36 new evaluation units. Use original15 input archives, all three seeds and all three exposed panels; development comparison, not independent confirmation.

noninferiority.orientation: D=(q,q) minus H=(zq,q) full-policy mean correct probability
noninferiority.statistics: Paired complete-case participant bootstrap within panel and endpoint. Missing omitted subjects are excluded before resampling in both models, with counts/IDs reported. Equal average of three panel differences within network, independent panel resampling; no network pooling. Lower95>=-.02 supports practical noninferiority; upper95<-.02 supports material inferiority; otherwise unresolved. CE is reported separately, no new CE tolerance.

decision.competence: Retain unchanged full/global generic and Liu learned/nonlearned lower95>.5 gates per cell. Invalid units do not support structure claims. Complete all models and all36 units unless integrity/nonfinite failure.
decision.core: Retain all five flags and historical nine descriptive rows, with conditional sampled diversity distinct from primary global all77 tau. Report all cells, failures and per-network core counts; do not require exact parent pass counts.
decision.compensation: Repeat the parent four-cell estimates and equal-panel summaries for duplicate-observation models. Report candidate-minus-hint-present differences of all equal-panel contrast effects with shared panel draw IDs. Main I_tau>0,I_CE<0,S_C-S_A<0 with both noise tau effects negative; do not require effect magnitudes equal to reference.
decision.preference: Development duplicate-observation replacement support requires all six trained models competent in their tested cells, all three Ce equal-panel five-endpoint noninferiority comparisons supported, core Ae and Ce each present on at least one panel in each of three networks, and all three network equal-panel main compensation intervals oriented as expected with negative noise simple effects. Evidence binding must be retained in every Ae/Ce cell. This bounded sufficiency rule is not a population success-rate claim; retain exact heterogeneous core counts and uncertain intervals.
decision.otherwise: Report competence, core, performance, direct improvement and compensation separately. No seed, threshold, scale, checkpoint or training-budget repair. Failure cannot establish universal need for z. Close this input-interface comparison and retain simple functional sufficiency; further mechanisms require a new question.

execution.freezes: Commit qualified source and protocol; then lock source, physical inputs, H/Z references and original dual anchor before training. Complete and commit all six final model locks before any new evaluation. Match all9000 pre-transform observed fingerprints and initial backbone hashes to H and Z, and all9000 q hashes to Z. Evaluate36 units, summarize once, conditionally validate merged-column export, then archive results.
execution.qualification: Check SAME-q duplication after both clean/noisy encoding and exact preservation of every other input; verify no metadata path into the RNN. CPU/GPU forward, P, gradient and Adam parity against independent eager rollout; both duplicate columns must have identical gradients. Qualify unchanged H collector against archived A0/2531/panel1. Fixed non-Liu merged-column mapping check; deleting column34 without summing is invalid.
execution.validation: Changed-file Ruff/format/type checks, affected numerical/statistical tests, architecture and documentation/registry checks. Focused independent checks of masks, paired probabilities and registered decision from saved summaries. No new estimands or repeated scientific evaluation beyond the frozen compact equivalence check.

outputs: canonical result: four cells, D-H probability and compensation effects, direct D-Z Ce probability, original dual cumulative Ce costs
six new weights/logs,36 raw/behavior/results, comparison draws/manifests; references retain ownership
conditional six merged-column checkpoints and equivalence record; no export if replacement gate fails
claim_boundary: Three paired training instances and three already-exposed panels; no pooling or independent confirmation.
D and Z have the same realized relation observation information. Explicit zq is absent, but p/z still generate q. One persistent plastic memory; unchanged single-stage learning.
D-Z measures an input-parameterization intervention, jointly changing effective initialization and optimization. It cannot separate these two causes or prove human mechanism.

Success is bounded recipe-level replacement support; failure does not show universal necessity of z. Numerical inference equivalence after merging does not establish training equivalence to a single column.
cumulative_cost: Secondary descriptive Ce duplicate-observation minus original dual probability for the same five groups, paired participant bootstrap and equal-panel means separately per network. Report intervals directly; do not infer cumulative noninferiority from successive deletion gates or add a new selection threshold.

compact_export.trigger: Only if all three paired instances pass the unchanged primary replacement rule against H. Direct improvement against Z is reported separately, not an added conjunction.
compact_export.mapping: Add trained input weight column34 into column37, then delete column34 in weights and inputs. Preserve bias, all other parameters and state dimensions. Original0..33->0..33,35->34,36->35,37(q)->36. Assert columns34/37 identical before mapping; both query columns zero. Study-specific37-channel ABI, not historical37. No optimizer-state mapping or second training.
compact_export.validation: All six models, both observation conditions, three panels and five input archives: compare intact generic/Liu logits, final P, first P, costs and writes; Liu also P_off, evidence-shuffle and each relation-removal control. Inherited atol1e-5 rtol1e-4, exact argmax and internal complete-graph order for intact and support interventions; exact argmax for P_off. Stop on mismatch, no tolerance adjustment. Export only as a numerically qualified representation.
compact_export.boundary: Floating-point inference equivalence only. Two trained parameter columns and Adam/clipping need not equal single-column training.

direct_improvement.contrast: D=(q,q) minus Z=(0,q), Ce, the same five probability endpoints for all three paired seeds
direct_improvement.statistics: Same participant IDs, eligibility masks, bootstrap seed and2000 counts as D-H. Equal-panel means within network and95% intervals. Lower95>0 supports improvement; upper95<0 supports worsening; otherwise uncertain. Report all15 comparisons; particular diagnostic interest in2531 generic learned/nonlearned. No across-network pooling, endpoint selection or additional replacement requirement.
direct_improvement.interpretation: Passing D-H noninferiority alone does not show D-Z improvement. Recovery, own phenotype and compensation are separate claims. No requirement to exceed Z on every endpoint.
